issues.jp_before: 切符[きっぷ]{は|wa-topic}駅[えき]{で|de-place}買[か]えます。
issues.problem: Non-focus topic slot: 切符が買えます is equally natural; alternative missing.

issues.jp_before: 公園[こうえん]{の|no-possessive}前[まえ]{の|no-possessive}道[みち]{を|o-path}まっすぐ歩[ある]いてください。
issues.problem: Distractor で (道で歩く) is only marked, not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor で with と.

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]{で|de-place}切符[きっぷ]{を|o-object}買[か]いました。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the other 'buy X at the station/shop' items in the file.
issues.action: Rewrote as 駅で友達を待ちました (I waited for my friend at the station), with a new why.

issues.jp_before: 新幹線[しんかんせん]{は|wa-topic}毎日[まいにち]朝[あさ]六時[ろくじ]{に|ni-time}東京[とうきょう]{を|o-departure}出[で]ます。
issues.problem: 毎日朝 is clumsy for 'every morning'; 東京から出ます is equally natural for a departing train.
issues.action: Changed to 毎朝 and slot to {を/から|o-departure}.

issues.jp_before: 空港[くうこう]{まで|made-until}電車[でんしゃ]{で|de-means}行[い]けます{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: 空港に行けますか is equally natural; alternative missing.

issues.jp_before: ホテル{は|wa-topic}駅[えき]{から|kara-from}近[ちか]いです。
issues.problem: 駅に近い is equally natural; alternative missing.

issues.jp_before: 京都[きょうと]{は/が|wa-topic}ここ{から|kara-from}近[ちか]いです{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of 空港は駅から遠いですか (same frame, same focus, same why).
issues.action: Replaced with この道は とても静かですね (wa-topic, focus slot 0).

issues.jp_before: 昨日[きのう]{の|no-possessive}電車[でんしゃ]{は/が|wa-topic}とても込[こ]んでいました。
issues.problem: 込む is the non-standard spelling (混む); distractor で (電車で混んでいた) is borderline acceptable.
issues.action: Changed to 混[こ]んで, replaced distractor で with と, lv 3 to 4.

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]{の|no-possessive}人[ひと]{に/から|ni-source}道[みち]{を|o-object}聞[き]きました。
issues.problem: English 'asked a person at the station the way' is unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'I asked someone at the station for directions.'

issues.jp_before: 朝[あさ]九時[くじ]{から|kara-from}夜[よる]六時[ろくじ]{まで|made-until}バス{が|ga-subject}走[はし]ります。
issues.problem: Six p.m. is normally 夕方, not 夜; English says 'evening'.
issues.action: Changed 夜 to 夕方[ゆうがた].
